item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs sku rgyud rtsod pa bzlog pa'i rgyud las dmardzas thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdud rtsi 'od zer 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs chog khrigs gsang chen rig 'dzin mchog lam ye shes zla ba'i snang ba
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rtsod pa bzlog pa'i rgyud las/ dam rdzas thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ bdud rtsi 'od zer 'khyil ba'i sgrabs thabs chog khrig (khrigs) gsang chen rig 'dzin mchog lam ye shes zla ba'i snang ba 'di nyid/ hor drug cu phur dgon 'o ma tshal gling du/ dus gso'i zhabs brtan bsgrub chen gsar 'dzug bgyis skabs bstan 'dzin skyes bu drang srong blo gros nyi ma gtsos 'dus grwa rnams nas ched du bskul ngor/ rig 'dzin chen po gyer dang rma yi gter lung las byon pa'i bdud rtsi 'od zer 'khyil ba'i sgrub gzhung la gzhir bzhag/ sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan dri med snying po'i skye 'phreng rim pa'i phyag len khungs thub kyi zur brgyan nas/ spa rigasasdom brtson g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags pas lcags lug rgyal zla'i tshes bzang por g.yung drung 'o tshal gling du bgyis pas gsang chen bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
